name: IDFC First Bank Limited
summary: IDFC First Bank Limited provides various banking and financial services in India. It operates through the Treasury, Corporate and Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Business segments. The company offers treasury and forex solutions, including correspondent banking, FX, cross-border swift, government bonds and strips, liberalized remittance scheme, and external commercial borrowing solutions, as well as treasury solutions comprising forwards, options, and swaps.
